== frame after_cd_minus cursor=5,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd /
|testuser@<HOST> / $ unset OLDPWD
|
|testuser@<HOST> / $ cd -
|<SHELL>: cd: no previous directory
|testuser@<HOST> / $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 /
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 unset
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 /
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
